# Applying for a building permit

Before you submit the application gather the site plan, the contractor's license number, and a written description of the work. Applications missing any of these are returned without review, and the thirty-day clock starts over when you resubmit.

Most residential permits are reviewed within thirty days. A second occurence of the same deficiency on a resubmitted application triggers a meeting with the plans examiner, which can be scheduled online.

Permits are valid for one year from the date of issue. Work that has not started within six months requires a renewal, which is free the first time.

labels.notes: Missing comma after an introductory "Before" clause plus a misspelling. "license" is the correct US spelling.
